The move's third horn gives existence a pro tanto weight, which is itself an axiological stake. HR-02 has an intrinsic-value-of-existence facet, but its gloss scopes the bedrock to the positive-states rebuttals' reliance on the asymmetry, and every tributary of that facet on this node ends at the terminal-value stake.
